messages:
ana: quick flag  PR 4250 updates the quickstart hello-min to use the new auth helper and a simplified deploy note. can someone sanity-check the token snippet and the deploy link?

jordan: i'll take a look. initial skim: snippets use `await Redwood.client({})` which is good, but the repo example still references `REDWOOD_TOKEN` env var instead of TOKEN; small mismatch.

priya: CI shows linkcheck failing for /guides/deploy-v2. that path moved to /guides/deploy/serverless. also one example shell block contains a js import line which breaks markdown highlight.

ci-bot: [build/4250] failed  docs-linkcheck error at docs/quickstarts/hello-min.md: broken link /guides/deploy-v2

ana: @jordan can you update the env var name in the sample repo or add a note? either is fine.

jordan: i'll add a tiny comment in the snippet: `# if your env is REDWOOD_TOKEN set TOKEN=REDWOOD_TOKEN` so folks copying won't be blocked. will also split the shell/js fenced blocks.

kevin: prefer not to upgrade the repo pin right now. let's keep the repo at v7 and make snippets dual-compatible: modern snippet first, then a one-line legacy hint. keeps friction low.

priya: sounds good. i'll change the broken link to /guides/deploy/serverless and re-run the linkcheck.

doc-bot: reminder: if example filename changed update quickstarts/index.yml and add a short changelog entry in docs/updates.md.

jordan: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4250  includes dual snippet, link fix, split fences, env hint. tests passing locally. reviewers: priya + ana.

ana: thanks! assigning reviewers. if green i'll merge midday and schedule site publish tonight.
